[features]
default = []
# 🗜️ Deflate segment compression (`CodecId(1)`); off by default so the pure contract stays dependency-light.
deflate = ["dep:semio-framework-deflate"]
# 🧪️ Cross-crate opt-in for `OrderedSet`'s hand-written `Serialize`/`Deserialize`
# (🌱️value/🗂️ordered/🧺️set/🦀️.rs's `ArrayWire` region). Plain `#[cfg(test)]` only covers THIS
# crate's own oracle test — a downstream crate's `#[cfg(test)]` build never activates a dependency
# crate's own `#[cfg(test)]` code, so a real cross-crate consumer (`os-flow`'s
# `Widget`/`FlowPreviewGui`, whose own `#[cfg_attr(test, derive(Serialize, Deserialize))]` needs
# this bound) must enable this feature explicitly instead.
ordered-set-serde = ["semio-framework-value/ordered-set-serde"]

semio-framework-trace = { path = "../../../⏱️trace/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }

semio-framework-io-base64 = { path = "../../../🚪️io/🔤️base64/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-value-derive = { path = "../../../🌱️value/✨️derive/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-value-derive" }
# 🚨️ RUNTIME-DEPENDENCY-ELIMINATION-FOR-S-PLUGINS-AND-ARTIFACTS (26/09/01, TENTH seam pass): STILL
# NOT movable to `[dev-dependencies]`, for three remaining reasons — see `📓️orderedmap-tenth-seam.md`.
# The ninth-seam pass's blocker (1) (the `to_dsl_value`/`from_dsl_value` and `encode_wire_serialized`/
# `decode_wire_serialized` bridges) stays resolved, unchanged from before. Blocker (2)'s FOURTH
# item — `🌱️value/🗂️ordered/🦀️.rs`'s `OrderedMap<V>: Serialize` (the real `os-kernel` neural-engine
# `Dictionary` caller) — is now ALSO resolved this pass: `Dictionary`, `Value`, `Atom`, `Neuron`,
# `Tree`, `FieldSpec`, `Schema`, `ChannelSpec`, `OperatorInfo`, `VariadicSpec`, `Cardinality` (all in
# `💻️os/🧠️neural/⚙️engine/🦀️.rs`) and `🌊️flow/🧩️extensions/🕸️wasm/🦀️.rs`'s `FlowExtension*` family
# moved to `ToValue`/`FromValue` + `pack::json`; `OrderedMap<V>: Serialize` is now `#[cfg(test)]`-only.
# THREE items of blocker (2) remain live and unconverted, each independently sufficient to keep
# `serde`/`serde_json` here — confirmed still present by direct read, not carried forward stale:
# - `🌱️value/🦀️.rs`'s `impl serde::Serialize/Deserialize for DslValue` (a deliberate, still-live
#   transitional bridge for OTHER serde-deriving types that hold a `DslValue` field, e.g. `ui_wgpu`'s
#   `ActionDescriptor`) and `impl From<&DslValue> for serde_json::Value` (real, actively-called
#   JSON-export/UI-boundary bridges, confirmed via `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗄️stdio`/`🏭️process` and the
#   `wgpu` UI target's own callers).
# - `🌱️value/🗂️ordered/🧺️set/🦀️.rs`'s `OrderedSet: Serialize + Deserialize` (real callers in
#   `💻️os/🔨️modules/🌊️flow/**` and the `🌀️procedural` plugins).
# - `InteractionState` and its `🕹️interaction/**` siblings, hit DIRECTLY via
#   `serde_json::to_string`/`from_str`/`from_slice`/`from_value`
#   (`💻️os/🔨️modules/🔌️plugin/🦀️.rs:9860,9864,9875`, `🕹️interaction/📃️query`/`📡️live`), never
#   through `encode_wire_serialized` — separate follow-up work, not covered by this pass.
# Do not attempt further per-type removal by grep-for-`serde_json`-near-the-name alone — the
# `MutationDescriptor` finding in `📓️replication-serde-removal.md` proved that method misses
# derive-based fan-out in `os-kernel`/`os` consumer structs; only a real `cargo check
# -p semio-framework-os-kernel` after the edit proves a type is safe to drop. This pass's own
# fan-out (`FieldSpec`/`Schema`/`ChannelSpec`/`OperatorInfo`, and `os-flow`'s `FlowExtension*`
# family) was found the same way — by removing the impl and reading the compiler, not by grepping.
serde = { version = "1.0.219", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0.140"

# 🌉️ `⚠️diagnostic`'s `fault_to_js`/`result_fault_to_js` hand a `Fault` across the JS boundary as a
# `JsValue`; `🧩️puzzle`'s `🌉️wasm` bridge calls them on ~20 lines, so the dep is retired together
# with those two functions and their callers, not ahead of them. Gated `not(target_env = "p2")`

# `💻️os`'s own browser-bridge block uses, and the reason those two functions carry the same cfg.

role = "framework"

[lints]
workspace = true

[lib]
path = "🦀️.rs"

[features]
default = []
testkit = ["wgpu-engine"]
# ⌨️ Terminal target: semio-styled scene/cell renderer, wasm-safe. Carries no platform I/O on its own.
tui = ["dep:semio-framework-async"]
# 🖥️ Native terminal backend for `tui`: raw mode, alt screen, stdin ANSI input decoding.
tui-terminal = ["tui", "dep:libc"]
# 🌐️ wasm-bindgen exports of the tui `WasmHost` for browser hosts (xterm.js); never default.
tui-bindgen = ["tui", "dep:wasm-bindgen"]
# 🧊️ wgpu target: declarative component types only, so wasm32-wasip2 program components stay light.
# Names the target, not the `wgpu` crate — that one only arrives with `wgpu-engine` below. `bytemuck`
# backs `draw_types::{UiInstance, VectorVertex}` (GPU vertex layout structs with zero `wgpu`-crate
# reference — pure `#[repr(C)]` value types); its own dependency is `bytemuck_derive`, a proc-macro
# that runs on the host at build time and links nothing into the target binary. `semio-framework-job`
# backs `prepared.rs`'s job-driven CPU staging/admission state machine (first-party, itself already
# wasip2-safe). Neither reintroduces the `wasm-bindgen` leak this ticket closes. Ticket
# 26/09/01/RUNTIME-DEPENDENCY-ELIMINATION-FOR-S-PLUGINS-AND-ARTIFACTS.
wgpu = ["dep:serde", "dep:serde_json", "dep:semio-framework-ui-locale", "dep:semio-framework-value-derive", "dep:bytemuck", "dep:semio-framework-job"]
# 🎨️ Full retained-mode engine for `wgpu`: arena/tree/layout/text/input/gpu rendering.
wgpu-engine = [
    "wgpu",
    "dep:parley",
    "dep:swash",
    "dep:bytemuck",
    "dep:winit",
    "dep:wgpu",
    "dep:taffy",
    "dep:js-sys",
    "dep:wasm-bindgen",
    "dep:web-sys",
    "dep:arboard",
    "dep:semio-framework-geometry",
    "dep:semio-framework-job",
    "dep:semio-framework-async",
    "dep:semio-framework-pixels",
]
# 🧬️ Enables the owned TypeScript schema projection for the `wgpu` boundary types.
typegen = ["wgpu"]

[dependencies]
semio-framework-value = { path = "../../../🌱️value/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
ui_styling = { path = "../../🎨️styling/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-ui-styling" }
# 🎬️ The 15 product scene structs (`World3dScene`/`TableScene`/...) and the generic 3D scene math
# both relocated out of this crate into `semio-framework-ui-scene` — ticket
# 26/08/17/MICROKERNEL-POOLED-ACTOR-PLUGIN-RUNTIME packet `scene-surface`. `component::ui` re-exports
# the former; `kernel_3d_scene` is now a re-export of the latter's `math` module. Non-optional: both
# are re-exported unconditionally from `component::ui`, which itself has no feature gate.
ui_scene = { path = "../../🎬️scene/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-ui-scene" }
# ⛓️ Consumed directly for the `wgpu-engine` widgets that still take `Camera3d` by value (see
# `widgets.rs`); `semio-framework-ui-scene`'s `math` module re-exports `Mat4`/`Vec3` from here too.
semio-framework-geometry = { path = "../../../📐️geometry/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-geometry", optional = true }
semio-framework-job = { path = "../../../🧵️job/📦️packages/🦀️rust", optional = true }
# 🖼️ Owned PNG codec (first-party, its only dependency is the owned DEFLATE module) backing
# `🎯️targets/🧊️wgpu/🖌️paint`'s `🖼️UiImageSources` region: a `Component::Image` whose `src` is a
# `data:image/png` URL decodes in-process instead of showing the placeholder box. No third-party
# image crate enters the graph — see that region's own docstring for the JPEG carve-out.
semio-framework-pixels = { path = "../../../🔲️pixels/📦️packages/🦀️rust", optional = true }
semio-framework-async = { path = "../../../⏳️async/📦️packages/🦀️rust", optional = true }
semio-framework-ui-locale = { path = "../../🌐️locale/📦️packages/🦀️rust", optional = true }
semio-framework-value-derive = { path = "../../../🌱️value/✨️derive/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-value-derive", optional = true }
ui_contract = { path = "../../🧬️contract/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-ui-contract" }
serde = { version = "1.0.219", features = ["derive"], optional = true }
serde_json = { version = "1.0.140", optional = true }
# 🖋️ Text shaping/font-fallback (parley) + rasterization (swash) for the `text` region's glyph
# atlas — versions match what `layout_rs` already resolves in the workspace lockfile (parley
# pulls fontique 0.5.0 transitively; accessed here via `parley::fontique`, not a direct dep).
# `no_std` + `libm` like `ui-render`: embedded font bytes only, no fontique path/mmap sources.
parley = { version = "0.5.0", default-features = false, features = ["libm"], optional = true }
swash = { version = "0.2.6", default-features = false, features = ["render", "std"], optional = true }
bytemuck = { version = "1.24.0", features = ["derive"], optional = true }
# ⚠️ RUNTIME-DEPENDENCY-ELIMINATION-FOR-S-PLUGINS-AND-ARTIFACTS (26/09/01): restored after an
# attempt to move this behind a `not(target_env = "p2")` target table — reverted because
# `♾️infinite`'s `🌍️world/🦀️.rs` unconditionally names wgpu-engine symbols that need this
# tier to exist even for `wasm32-wasip2`. See `🎯️targets/🧊️wgpu/🦀️.rs`'s top docstring.
wgpu = { version = "29.0.4", default-features = false, features = ["std", "wgsl"], optional = true }
# 📐️ The retained target's production layout solver (`🎯️targets/🧊️wgpu/📐️flex`). `grid` joins
# `flexbox` because `LayoutSpec::Grid` is a first-class contract variant React renders as real CSS
# grid — same feature set `semio-framework-ui-render` already resolves for the same reason.
taffy = { version = "0.9", default-features = false, features = ["std", "flexbox", "grid", "taffy_tree"], optional = true }

[target.'cfg(not(target_os = "wasi"))'.dependencies]
winit = { version = "0.30.12", default-features = false, features = ["rwh_06"], optional = true }

# 🐧️ winit's Linux backends are features; these load their system libraries at run time (no dev packages).
[target.'cfg(target_os = "linux")'.dependencies]

# 🌉️ Browser-only device/session bindings (`🎯️targets/🧊️wgpu`'s canvas/clipboard/fetch/cursor
# bridges — cursor.rs, prepared.rs, host.rs, text.rs, gpu.rs — plus `tui-bindgen`'s xterm.js

    pub fn validate() -> Result<(), String> {
        let mut names = HashSet::with_capacity(TYPES.len());
        for metadata in TYPES {
            if metadata.version == 0 {
                return Err(format!("schema '{}' has version zero", metadata.name));
            }
            if !names.insert(metadata.name) {
                return Err(format!("duplicate schema '{}'", metadata.name));
            }
            let type_prefix = format!("export type {}", metadata.name);
            let interface_prefix = format!("export interface {}", metadata.name);
            if !metadata.typescript.contains(&type_prefix) && !metadata.typescript.contains(&interface_prefix) {
                return Err(format!("schema '{}' declaration has a mismatched name", metadata.name));
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn render_typescript() -> String {
        let mut output = String::from("/** @generated by `bun nx run @semio-tech/framework:generate` from versioned owned framework schema metadata. Do not edit. */\n\nimport type { Label, StyleSpec, MenuRef as UiMenuRef, RowActionPlacement as UiTreeActionPlacement, Tone, WindowStackCorner } from \"../📜️ui-contract/🟦️.ts\";\nimport type { ShellLocale as Locale, ShellTerminology as Terminology } from \"../🎚️ui-axes/🟦️.ts\";\n\n");
        for (index, metadata) in TYPES.iter().enumerate() {
            output.push_str(metadata.typescript);
            output.push_str(if index + 1 == TYPES.len() { "\n" } else { "\n\n" });
        }
        output
    }

pub fn resolve_registry_plugin_id(plugin_filter: &str) -> &str {
    for (variant, plugin_id) in PLAYGROUND_VARIANT_REGISTRY_IDS {
        if *variant == plugin_filter {
            return plugin_id;
        }
    }
    plugin_filter
}

pub fn resolve_playground_app_id(plugin_filter: &str) -> Option<&'static str> {
    PLAYGROUND_VARIANT_APP_IDS.iter().find_map(|(variant, app_id)| (*variant == plugin_filter).then_some(*app_id))
}

pub fn resolve_plugin_host_config(plugin_filter: &str) -> Option<&'static PluginHostConfig> {
    let registry_id = resolve_registry_plugin_id(plugin_filter);
    PLUGIN_HOST_CONFIGS.iter().find(|entry| entry.plugin_id == registry_id)
}

pub fn is_space_mode(plugin_filter: &str) -> bool {
    resolve_plugin_host_config(plugin_filter).is_some()
}
